q2.answer: Step 2 matches every active subscription with the same account_id whose event_types contains the event type or '*'. In one transaction, the events row is inserted with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING on its primary key event_id; a redelivered message hits that conflict, so it is acked and nothing else is written. A new event gets one deliveries row per matched subscription, with ON CONFLICT (event_id, subscription_id) DO NOTHING as a second guard.

q6.answer: The deliveries table in the service database holds it: status (pending, in_flight, delivered or dead), attempt_count, next_attempt_at, lease_until, lease_token, the last status code or error, and dead_at.

q7.answer: The wait lives in the database. The delivery stays pending with next_attempt_at set to now plus the wait (30 s, 2 min, 10 min, 30 min, 1 h, 3 h, 6 h). Every worker polls once a second for pending rows whose next_attempt_at has passed, and claims them with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED. The queue carries no delayed messages for retries, so the 15-minute limit does not matter.

q8.answer: The delivery stays in_flight until its 60 s lease expires. The reaper then clears the lease, keeps the lost attempt in attempt_count, and either schedules the next attempt on the normal wait or, if the count has reached 8, marks it dead. The receiver may have already seen the first request, so it can get the same delivery id again.

q9.answer: Dead deliveries stay in the service deliveries table with status dead and dead_at set, and support lists them per subscription with the last status code or error. They are deleted by a cleanup job 14 days after dead_at. A replay is allowed only if the subscription is active; it keeps the same delivery id, sets attempt_count to 0, sets status to pending, and sets next_attempt_at to now, which starts a fresh cycle of 8 attempts.

q11.answer: Nothing is cancelled when the subscription is disabled. Its pending deliveries stay pending until a worker claims them, and the status check in step 5 then marks each one dead without sending a request. Replay of any of them is refused while the subscription stays disabled. The document does not say whether a sweep marks them dead sooner, so that is not decided.
